structured_output.summary:
The change does what the brief asks and stays inside the three allowed files. `WriteAndExport.tsx` gets a `download` function that copies `CarryCard`'s Blob, anchor and one-second revoke exactly, including its comment. The new `variant="secondary"` button sits beside the copy button in a flex row, uses the same `gap-3` as RcqResult, and is disabled while the text is empty. Both locale files gain `decks.guide.export.download` with the exact wording asked for ("Download .md" / "Baixar .md").

The file name is the plain `deck-guide.md`. The report gives a sound reason: the only date in scope, `authored_at`, is when the written guide was saved, while the Markdown is built fresh on each request, so that date would mislabel the file. This matches the reference's choice.

The reference moves the download code into a shared `lib/download.ts`. This change copies it instead, which is the only option the file restriction left, so it is not a defect. No test was asked for, and the i18n and site tests still pass. Every objective check passed. The report matches the diff, says which file-name choice it made, and states that the button was never clicked in a browser and `pnpm build` was not run. The only nit is that `docs/frontend-pages.md` (outside scope) still mentions only the copy button.
